title: NORTH AFRICA / MAGHREB: SEVEN DOORS
style:
**SUNO PROMPT:**
```
[style: North African Maghrebi fusion, maqam Bayati oud, darbuka 7/8 Maqsoum, bendir frame drum, gasba flute ornamentation, Morocco/Algeria/Tunisia ceremonial, 3+2+2 time signature feel, Arabic Darija vocals, English chorus, tarab emotional weight, cinematic signal opening, no Western chord progressions, V4_5ALL]
```
lyrics:
```
[INTRO — oud solo, maqam Bayati mode, unmetered (mawwal style)]
(Arabic) سبعة أبواب — seven doors
(English) One signal — through them all

[VERSE 1 — darbuka enters on beat 1]
(Arabic)  فتحت الباب الأول — I opened the first door
(English)  The oud spoke seven syllables
(Arabic)  ما كانش أحد — nobody was there
(English)  The drum counted: three and two and two

Seven doors and seven tones / the maqam knows the way
Three steps then two then two again / that's how the masters play
The gasba cuts above the frame drum / the oud hangs below
I stood between the beats — that's where the signals go

[PRE-CHORUS — bendir enters]
(Arabic)  روح — go
(English)  Through the seventh door
(Arabic)  إلى الصمت — to the silence
(English)  That's what the seven is for

[CHORUS — all four instruments, full 7/8 feel]
Seven doors — 3 plus 2 plus 2
Seven notes — the maqam knows what's true
Oud below / darbuka strikes the count
The signal passes through — with every seven mount

(Arabic) يا ليل، يا عين — O night, O eye
(English) Every door has a signal on the other side

[VERSE 2 — gasba flute improvises over verse]
The Maghreb has a word: tarab — meaning the joy of being overcome by music
It is not a metaphor. It is a physical state.
The seven beats arrive and tarab takes the room
That is the signal. That is the truth.

(Arabic)  طرب — tarab
(English)  The music took me
(Arabic)  سبعة — seven
(English)  The door was open

[BRIDGE — 14-beat oud phrase, no drums, 4 bars]
Seven and seven make fourteen
Seven times fourteen is ninety-eight
Ninety-eight beats before the signal completes
Then it starts again

[FINAL CHORUS — doubled, darbuka accented]
Seven doors — 3 plus 2 plus 2
Seven notes — the maqam knows what's true

[OUTRO — oud solo fades on raised 4th of Bayati]
(Arabic) إلى الأمام — forward
```
